thread:
maria: Quick sync — we need to finalize the StratusIQ case study and lock a webinar slot. Draft doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1STRATUSQ-DRAFT :eyes:

jake: Reading now. Can we get a short pull quote from their VP of Eng? 1-2 lines, strong on latency/cost.

sophia: For webinar planning, what weekend/date windows should we avoid? I have 2nd week of May blocked for the analyst summit.

maria: Avoid May 8-12. Target May 18 or 19 (Thu/Fri) for webinar. Need case published ~48h before webinar for promotional routing.

elaine: I can do a legal sweep but need the final transcript and any customer-provided logos. 24–36 hour turnaround. Please @ me when the doc is updated. :lock:

rahul: I’ll drop the benchmark blurb and a compact chart snapshot into the doc. Proposed blurb: "Using Redwood Dedicated, StratusIQ reduced median p99 latency from 420ms to 220ms while cutting per-token inference cost by ~37% using quantized v2 settings." Happy to refine.

jake: Nice — I’ll shape that into a one-sentence highlight for the case opener. Also prepping 2 quote options: raw quote + shortened for social.

lex: For inbound lead routing, confirm tags and SFDC campaign. I suggest tags: `case_study`, `stratusiq`, `webinar_may18`. Will map to CAM-3812. Do we need an MQL threshold override?
sophia: Yes, please route webinar signups to Demand Gen first; Sales should get MQLs with >50% engagement. lex can you set that rule?

lex: On it — mapping: `case_study`,`stratusiq`,`webinar_may18` -> SFDC campaign CAM-3812; MQL if attended >= 50% or watched recording and completed survey. I’ll create the campaign and share access.

calendar-bot: Event created: "StratusIQ: Customer Story + Webinar (Draft)" May 18 10:00-11:00 PT — https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=STRATUSIQ-WEBINAR :calendar:

jake: Uploading draft pull quotes to the doc: 1) "Redwood cut our latency nearly in half — game changer for real-time features." 2) Short: "Latency down, costs down." Need sign-off from StratusIQ PR.

maria: @jake please tag the doc with "FOR LEGAL REVIEW" when you add final quotes. Elaine — heads up, some initial language mentions internal metrics; legal will need to verify customer ok with numbers.

elaine: Confirmed. Also request: remove any customer email addresses and PII from screenshots. If they share a PDF with internal IDs we need them redacted before publish.

rahul: I’ll attach the chart png (no customer PII) and a text-only benchmark table. For the one-line highlight, approve this sanitized phrasing: "median p99 latency improved from ~420ms to ~220ms on comparable workloads."

jake: That phrasing looks good to me. @maria can you check with StratusIQ press contact whether they want their logo used and which title to attribute the quote to?

maria: Reached out to their PR (emma@stratusiq.com). Waiting on logo and official quote attribution (VP or CTO). Emma said they can confirm by EOD tomorrow.

sophia: For promotional narrative, I’ll prepare: blog post, 2 social cards, 1 paid ad creative, and webinar registration page. Need final headline by May 13 COB to start creative.

lex: Sales ops — once case publishes, I’ll include a CTA on the registration page that creates a lead with tags and `case_study` cookie so we can attribute source. Also will add `utm_campaign=stratusiq_case` to all assets.

maria: Status check: doc link updated + benchmarks in place?

jake: Done — uploaded benchmarks and two quote options. Marked section with "FOR LEGAL REVIEW".

elaine: Reviewing now. Two quick redlines: 1) remove "real-time" claim unless StratusIQ signs off on production traffic example; 2) change exact cost delta to "approx." unless they provide billing export.

rahul: Can we keep the numbers and add "approx" prefix? Example: "approx 37% per-token cost savings". That should be safe.

maria: OK — change applied. @emma please confirm logo + final quote and whether StratusIQ is ok with the approximate numbers.

calendar-bot: Reminder in 24h: StratusIQ PR follow-up.

sophia: Also, who will be the webinar moderator? I can moderate but need a tech co-presenter from Product. @rahul can you present the benchmark slide and join the panel?

rahul: Yep, I can do the demo/benchmark section.

maria: Final items before we close: - Legal sign-off (elaine) - Customer quote attribution confirmed (emma) - Webinar registration + assets live by May 13 COB - Lead routing/campaign created (lex) - Social copy & ad creative ready (sophia & jake)

jake: I’ll ping you if I need shorter copy for paid.

elaine: I should have legal sign-off within 24 hours of current doc changes. :thumbsup:

lex: Campaign created draft, will share CAM-3812 access after I finish the mapping tonight.

maria: Thanks team — keeping this thread as single source of truth. I’ll update when we get logo/quote. :white_check_mark:
